description: The ResponseCB ends the conversation from C logic (strstr on the response body, then WEB_ASYNC_CB_RC_ABORT_ASYNC_NOT_ERROR), which the callback translation does not take on. The conversation still runs and web_stop_async still ends it, so the wire traffic matches, but the callback's lr_save_string does not run either: the import carries a promotion finding and the result URL keeps the unresolved parameter.
source: VuGen 26.1 Function Reference: web_reg_async_attributes (ID, Pattern, URL, PollIntervalMs, RequestCB, ResponseCB, ResponseBodyBufferCB), web_stop_async, web_sync (ParamValueEquals, Timeout); Asynchronous communication: callbacks in AsyncCallbacks.c.
